implementation: Inventory requests share one computation; events and fail counters invalidate the snapshot, with a 2s missed-event safety TTL. Changes during an active read trigger one trailing refresh instead of repeated aborts. Per-HTTP-request compute admission remains enforced for coalesced waiters.
Capture queue fetches only visible Stock-Date counts in batches of at most 200 using the inventory metadata source priority; it no longer observes the full inventory query.
Collector state transmits changed peak keys. First/overwritten/desired-version-change frames recover with full snapshots; sequence gaps fail closed and late RPC replies cannot rewind newer state.

Closed views keep at most 64 compact timestamped ladders, restorable only within 30s of the snapshot. Subscriptions and indicator history still release immediately; code/date/venue/freshness/order gates stay in place.

After candles settle, hoga and sidecars share a 200ms reveal budget. Existing viewport positioning, two animation frames and 160ms fade remain; pending indicators have a status label. View identity prevents spent-budget leakage.
Candle/indicator cache policy remains 64 codes / 128 snapshots / 512MiB.

browserComparison.method: Browser performance.now around real workspace symbol replacement; per-rAF checks require the new code candle close plus cover fade completion, and a matching public book price. Fixture last response completion timestamps are measured separately.
browserComparison.baseline: Exact test-only legacy policy overrides matching base 83aedf349: 700ms sidecar-only budget, unbounded hoga wait, and no retained ladder restoration. No production override exists.

workload.scope: synthetic transport delays; empty auxiliary cards; public book only; not real vendor/server load

browserComparison.interpretation: Cold first chart becomes usable sooner; fixed upstream response completion stays effectively unchanged. Revisits restore a recent ladder without waiting for the next mocked subscription frame.
limitations: Synthetic API delays and candles; auxiliary investor cards lack vendor data, so allResponsesMs is completion of the instrumented candle/range/series fixture responses, not full 7-window market-data completeness.
Private balances, orders and trading readiness are excluded. A restored ladder is not proof of a new market tick.

The benchmark still logs pre-existing Maximum update depth warnings (legacy 32, improved 6) on its synthetic/incomplete setup. Unhandled page errors were zero; this is not a claim of a warning-free live workload.
Small samples: medians describe this workload, not a production p95 or a guaranteed improvement percentage.

backendComparison.limitations: Offline Pydantic serialization/IPC CPU+bytes experiment. Excludes filesystem scan, socket scheduling and real vendor traffic. Real API server GC/latency changes were not measured after deployment.

deployment: This task only changes its worktree. It did not restart or modify user localhost:5173/8000 servers or the primary checkout.
